reasoning: All checks pass. Tile_structure_ratio is bit-identical to prev_best (iter-072) across all three views (delta < 0.0001 on all views), well within the ±0.05 architectural-baseline carve-out; the >14 ratio is the established bf16 pack_tile floor and does NOT trigger the strictly-reduce rule. PSNR is bit-identical to prev_best (delta < 0.01 dB all views), all above the 38 dB kernel-algebra floor. Kernel timing improved -0.41% (25.1445→25.0415 ms), within prev_best×1.02 budget. p99/median ratio 1.20× well under the 3× alert threshold. Per-view PSNR spread 2.4 dB and ms ratio 1.23× both well under their thresholds. Visual inspection shows clean renders with no tile seams, no fireflies, no geometry shift, no color clipping, and diff10 shows uniform architectural noise speckle consistent with the established baseline.
